title: Bounded Temporal-Certificate Cost and Reference Runtime Overhead Characterization
purpose: Characterize only the incremental compute and transient-memory cost of the already-qualified reference-Richards temporal certificate machinery. PE06 does not select H_budget, change physics or solver fidelity, or define BALANCED/THROUGHPUT policy.

qualified_dependency.nonclaim: No numeric H_budget is selected, recommended or qualified by F-VQ34 or F-PE06.

included: accepted right-derivative history snapshot and replacement
one defect reference_tridag solve when admitted seeded history exists
scalar normalization using an already-supplied positive test-oracle budget
incremental transient allocation and copy cost

source_bound_inventory.role: Optional F-KT numerical-continuation carrier. snapshot and replace allocate/copy O(n) vectors; payload is explicitly not physical storage.
Current derivative, constitutive reevaluation, operator/defect assembly, one reference_tridag correction, norms and source-declared additional solve counters.
reference_tridag combines forward elimination and backward substitution; no separate factorization event is exposed.
Principal solve diagnostics and temporal-indicator result counters.

Enables temporal service from numerical_continuation_layout_id, performs principal solve, invokes temporal service after convergence, accumulates defect solve into linear_solves, replaces history and normalizes by supplied budget.
Defines TX_TEMPORAL_NONE, allowing A/B timing with identical transaction acceptance while B still executes the runtime temporal service.
Frozen qualified fixture family. VALID_ACCEPT constructs H_budget=2*direct_Binf only as a test oracle forcing C_h=0.5; this is not application policy.

same_in_both_arms: canonical config including the same positive frozen test-oracle budget value
mass tolerance and single-attempt transaction policy

arm_B.previous_right_derivative: seeded using the frozen F-VQ34 fixture construction
arm_B.budget_rule: reuse the frozen F-VQ34 positive test-oracle construction unchanged; PE06 never tunes or ranks it

paired_runtime_design.rationale: TX_TEMPORAL_NONE prevents certificate-driven accept/reject/retry differences while the model still executes the temporal service in arm B.
paired_runtime_design.warmup: untimed warmup before each measured compiler/case block
paired_runtime_design.timing_unit: fixed-size batches large enough to dominate clock resolution; report per-trial values
paired_runtime_design.real_matrix: reuse all 12 frozen F-VQ34 hydraulic cases without post-result deletion
paired_runtime_design.synthetic_size_sweep: optional complexity/allocation characterization only; never production acceptance evidence

pre_timing_hard_gates: A and B each execute exactly one principal Richards trajectory per attempt
A and B principal nonlinear_iterations, jacobian_builds, internal_retries and backtracking_attempts match
B temporal_additional_tridiagonal_solves=1 on admitted seeded-history cases
B total linear_solves=A total linear_solves+1 when principal diagnostics match
A/B candidate physical pressure_head, water_content, ponding_depth and groundwater_level are bitwise identical
A/B strict physical mass accounting and residual are bitwise identical
only B carries optional derivative continuation data

metrics.defect_tridiagonal_solves: required separately via temporal observation and A/B delta
metrics.history_operations: required structural count; component timing permitted
metrics.normalization: required structural count; component timing permitted if clock resolution is adequate
metrics.allocations_and_scratch_bytes: report only with reliable instrumentation; otherwise report source-bound sites/O(n) shape without invented byte counts

component_microbenchmarks: history snapshot/replace at fixed sizes and fixed iteration counts
temporal indicator on a precomputed converged solve_result so principal nonlinear solve time is excluded
scalar normalization/diagnostic propagation using the frozen positive test-oracle budget construction

H1.statement: Temporal service adds zero full nonlinear Richards trajectories.

H2.statement: Admitted seeded-history evaluation adds exactly one combined defect reference_tridag solve.

H3.statement: Under TX_TEMPORAL_NONE the temporal service leaves physical candidate and strict mass result bitwise unchanged.

H4.statement: Incremental temporal-service work is O(n) in vertical node count within the admitted reference-Richards envelope.

reporting_rules: Keep source-declared counters separate from empirically observed runtime counters.
Keep component timing separate from end-to-end paired runtime timing.
Do not invent a separate defect factorization metric.
Report O0 and O2 independently before pooled summaries.
Any physical or mass identity failure invalidates performance interpretation.
A finite matrix characterizes observed timing tails only; it is not a hardware-independent bound.

architecture_invariants.3: H_budget remains numerical configuration and history remains optional numerical continuation data.
architecture_invariants.5: Indicator arrays/workspace remain transient or worker-local; PE06 introduces no persistent per-column scratch.
architecture_invariants.7: A/B uses normal checkpoint/trial/commit machinery; TX_TEMPORAL_NONE is only an isolation device for timing.
architecture_invariants.13: Physical mass identity is a hard precondition for timing interpretation.
architecture_invariants.23: Only numerical continuation layout differs; physical options and reference solver settings remain fixed.
architecture_invariants.24: Characterize fixed solve-count shape and observed timing/tails without universal runtime claims.
architecture_invariants.25: Reference Richards mode remains the characterized path.
architecture_invariants.26: Existing solver and temporal diagnostics are first-class evidence.
architecture_invariants.30: Any instrumentation source change requires explicit reconciliation before evidence acceptance.

forbidden_claims: No universal wall-clock bound from finite hardware data.
No PE06 qualification before paired O0/O2 evidence and equivalence gates are persisted and reproducible.
